description.narrative: HCFC phase-out management plan, Stage I (conversion from HCFC-141b to HFCs in the manufacture of polyurethane foam for the commercial refrigeration units, sandwich panels and insulated doors). The first stage of the strategy covers the freeze of HCFCs consumption in 2013 (base level - annual consumption in 2009-2010) and 10% reduction of HCFCs consumption in 2015.
